scope: Compiler-facing framing, representation, identity, admission boundaries and evidence-accounting reference contracts; no production runtime qualification
partition_measure: Passed unittest method IDs; individual codec mutation/arithmetic cases are recorded separately in execution logs. A listed method is a requirement, not a claimed observation.

witnesses.oracle: Hand-derived 48-byte header and ten canonical directory records; independent Python/Rust/C++ parsing and legacy/candidate API separation.
Hand-derived ordered primitive/record bytes, independent encoder/decoder comparison.
All merged candidate record variants independently encoded and decoded; shape validity confers no authority.
Actual ten-root bundle and independently assembled content-identity preimage; only named self identity zeroed.
Actual ABI/execution/runtime checks, independently rehashed module and sequential reference result42.
Source-ABI wrapper versus multiresult primitive, actual issued pointer and single-use effect frontier.
Separate allocation/value bindings, actual relocated origin and TLS expression27+7+8=42.
Zero-length payload and maximum optional section kind, strict canonical placement.
Exact declared section resource boundary and rejection above it.
Fixed-width signed minima/maxima and unsigned limits with canonical widths.
None, Some(None) and nested present values have distinct canonical bytes.
Shortest scalar UTF-8, no implicit normalization, invalid scalar encodings reject.
Depth/node/string/vector/materialization boundaries checked before unbounded expansion.
Deterministic independent header/directory mutation classification and diagnostic agreement.
Every actual envelope prefix rejects at its specified structural boundary.
Independent C++ encoder rejects out-of-range, malformed primitive and shape inputs.
Missing/wrong root, identity, revision and conflicting exact schema definitions reject.
Four complete binary fixtures must reach exact runtime source-function/TLSinit/TLSdtor/import-signature errors; setup/schema failures do not qualify.
Either derived gate value inside immutable candidate registry rejects.
All four mutable accounting paths, including an in-tree alias, are forbidden candidate artifacts.
Changed source bytes invalidate a previous witness receipt.
An additional discovered dependency invalidates incomplete receipt inventory.

independence.codecs: Python, Rust and C++ share exact schema tables; encoding/decoding logic is independently implemented. Hand-audited golden bytes provide an independent oracle.
independence.semantics: Actual ABI/execution/runtime owner implementations and independent LLVM comparison are composed; this integration is not itself a fourth independent semantic engine.
independence.accounting: Synthetic gate tests exercise false-green rejection only; they do not supply platform conformance evidence.

limitations: No production executable token, portable interpreter/JIT, native exception domain or parallel guest execution.
CONFs for six-host execution, concurrency and native interoperability specify subsequent release gates; this reference suite does not claim those hosts or behaviors.
Full compiler component approval also requires exact artifact review, all named candidate-digest acknowledgments and independent qualifying receipts; no test count alone changes status.
